fact: In the second half of 2021 electronic money issuers across the West African Monetary Union, Mali included, received 2.65 million customer complaints, mostly on wrong deposit or transfer beneficiary accounts, phone number changes and cancelled transfers; the figure is not broken out for Mali.
title: Rapport semestriel de surveillance des moyens et services de paiement à fin décembre 2021
publisher: Banque Centrale des États de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (BCEAO)
